'''Zac''' was a boy who showed [[The Force/Legends|Force]] potential, but was not chosen to progress on to a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], but instead assigned to work on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. He had a connection with animals, and used this ability to help his friends defeat the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] when they attacked during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Once they were safely in space, Zac suggested that their ultimate destination should be the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to graduate at last.<ref name="CWA 10" />
